description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of narrative media framing biases. The chart contains four slices, representing “Right bias”, “Left bias”, “Left center bias”, and an unlabeled fourth category. The “Right bias” slice is blue and represents 30.0% (30) of the total. The “Left bias” slice is orange and represents 28.0% (28) of the total. The “Left center bias” slice is green and represents 22.0% (22) of the total. The remaining unlabeled slice is red and represents 20.0% (20) of the total. Percentage labels and corresponding counts are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest slice and decreasing in size. A legend is not present, but the slices are labeled directly on the chart.
